description: This file defines the UsersRepository class with methods for managing user data, including creation, updates, retrieval, and deletion, using Prisma ORM in a NestJS application.

classes.name: UsersRepository
classes.description: Repository class for user data operations, including CRUD, profile management, email verification, and related user functionalities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified details and associates it with an OAuth client.

methods.name: addToOAuthClient
methods.description: Associates an existing user with an OAuth client.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique ID.

methods.name: findByIdWithinPlatformScope
methods.description: Finds a user by ID within the scope of platform-managed users and OAuth client.

methods.name: findByIdWithProfile
methods.description: Retrieves a user along with their profile and organization details.

methods.name: findOwnerByTeamIdWithProfile
methods.description: Finds the owner user of a specific team with profile details.

methods.name: findByIdsWithEventTypes
methods.description: Fetches multiple users by IDs including their event types.

methods.name: findByIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple users by their IDs.

methods.name: findByIdWithCalendars
methods.description: Gets a user with their associated calendars.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a user by email.

methods.name: findByEmailWithProfile
methods.description: Finds a user by email including profile and organization info.

methods.name: findByUsernameWithProfile
methods.description: Finds a user by username with profile and organization info.

methods.name: findByUsername
methods.description: Finds a user by username, optionally filtered by organization slug or ID.

methods.name: findManagedUsersByOAuthClientId
methods.description: Retrieves managed users associated with a specific OAuth client.

methods.name: findManagedUsersByOAuthClientIdAndEmails
methods.description: Retrieves managed users associated with an OAuth client filtered by emails.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates user data by user ID.

methods.name: updateByEmail
methods.description: Updates user data by email.

methods.name: updateUsername
methods.description: Updates a user's username.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a user by ID.

methods.name: setDefaultSchedule
methods.description: Sets the default schedule for a user.

methods.name: getUserScheduleDefaultId
methods.description: Retrieves the default schedule ID for a user.

methods.name: getUsersScheduleDefaultIds
methods.description: Retrieves default schedule IDs for multiple users.

methods.name: getOrganizationUsers
methods.description: Gets all users belonging to an organization.

methods.name: setDefaultConferencingApp
methods.description: Sets the default conferencing app for a user.

methods.name: findUserOOORedirectEligible
methods.description: Checks if a user is eligible for OOO redirect to another user.

methods.name: getOrgsManagedUserEmailsBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves emails of managed users by subscription ID.

methods.name: getActiveManagedUsersAsHost
methods.description: Gets active managed users as hosts within a time range.

methods.name: getActiveManagedUsersAsAttendee
methods.description: Gets active managed users as attendees within a time range.

methods.name: getUserEmailsVerifiedForTeam
methods.description: Retrieves verified emails for users in a team.

methods.name: findVerifiedSecondaryEmail
methods.description: Finds a verified secondary email for a user.

methods.name: swapPrimaryEmailWithSecondaryEmail
methods.description: Swaps primary email with a secondary email for a user.
